usage.useWhen: One short, time-bound message with an optional link as a band over the full width at the top of the header, such as an event or a change of opening hours. Use the pattern Header with announcement to place it above the header.
usage.avoidWhen: Permanent information, cookie notices or several messages at once; use page content instead. Do not place it inside a section of the page.
usage.a11y: The bar is a region; give it a label that names it as an announcement. Keep the text to one sentence with at most one link. Keep the default colors (ink on surface-alt), use the style Inverse (surface on ink) or pick another contract pair; the link stays underlined.
